pages.text: Great ziggurats stand in the Jurassic, older than any people, and each is built round an $(l)obelisk$(): the same black stone that stands at that spot in my own time. Inside, a $(l)Temporal Core$() hangs from the obelisk on sinews and holds everything still: nothing can be placed or broken. Raptors guard the halls.

Five seals lock the core, each opened by a different gift of the glands:$(br)$(l)Heavy$(): Iron Fists, or a Ground Slam.$(br)$(l)Narrow$(): at the end of a crawlspace; Shrink.$(br)$(l)Swift$(): run into it faster than a sprint; Quickening.$(br)$(l)Veiled$(): hidden in a wall; Glowing Sight.$(br)$(l)Stilled$(): slow or stop its time.
pages.title: The Seals

pages.text: Any three will do. Then the core stills, the barrier falls, and the core itself can be taken: a $(l)Stilled Core$(), all the time it held. Crushed, it fills my Time.
pages.title: Breaking In
